Added `redis.NewClient` with TLS 1.2, connected it to gRPC cache setup, added YAML fixtures and TLS trust tests, and registered `api/cachetls` in the integration runner and GitHub Actions matrix.

The Dagger integration case was not executed locally because it requires container images.

+func cacheTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
+	ca, cert, key, err := redisTLSCertificates()
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+
+	redis := client.Container().
+		From("redis:alpine").
+		WithNewFile("/etc/redis/ca.pem", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: string(ca)}).
+		WithNewFile("/etc/redis/server.pem", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: string(cert)}).
+		WithNewFile("/etc/redis/server-key.pem", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: string(key)}).
+		WithExposedPort(6379).
+		WithExec([]string{
+			"redis-server", "--port", "0", "--tls-port", "6379",
+			"--tls-cert-file", "/etc/redis/server.pem",
+			"--tls-key-file", "/etc/redis/server-key.pem",
+			"--tls-ca-cert-file", "/etc/redis/ca.pem",
+			"--tls-auth-clients", "no",
+		})
+
+	flipt = flipt.
+		WithServiceBinding("redis", redis.AsService()).
+		WithNewFile("/etc/flipt/redis-ca.pem", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: string(ca)}).
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_PATH", "/etc/flipt/redis-ca.pem")
+
+	return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)
+}
+
+func redisTLSCertificates() (ca, cert, key []byte, err error) {
+	caKey, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, nil, err
+	}
+
+	now := time.Now()
+	caTemplate := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "Redis integration CA"},
+		NotBefore:             now.Add(-time.Minute),
+		NotAfter:              now.Add(time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+		IsCA:                  true,
+	}
+	caDER, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, caTemplate, caTemplate, &caKey.PublicKey, caKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, nil, err
+	}
+
+	serverKey, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, nil, err
+	}
+	serverTemplate := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber: big.NewInt(2),
+		Subject:      pkix.Name{CommonName: "redis"},
+		DNSNames:     []string{"redis"},
+		NotBefore:    now.Add(-time.Minute),
+		NotAfter:     now.Add(time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:     x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
+		ExtKeyUsage:  []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+	}
+	serverDER, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, serverTemplate, caTemplate, &serverKey.PublicKey, caKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, nil, err
+	}
+	keyDER, err := x509.MarshalECPrivateKey(serverKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, nil, err
+	}
+
+	return pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: caDER}),
+		pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: serverDER}),
+		pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "EC PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: keyDER}), nil
+}

diff --git a/internal/cache/redis/client.go b/internal/cache/redis/client.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e492e3c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client.go
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient constructs a Redis client from the cache configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{
+			MinVersion:         tls.VersionTLS12,
+			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS,
+		}
+
+		var caCert []byte
+		if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+			var err error
+			caCert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+			}
+		} else if cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+			caCert = []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+		}
+
+		if len(caCert) > 0 {
+			roots := x509.NewCertPool()
+			if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(caCert) {
+				return nil, errors.New("invalid redis CA certificate: no certificates found in PEM data")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}
diff --git a/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go b/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..36d7238
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"encoding/pem"
+	"errors"
+	"net"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+func TestNewClientTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	server := httptest.NewTLSServer(nil)
+	defer server.Close()
+
+	ca := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{
+		Type:  "CERTIFICATE",
+		Bytes: server.Certificate().Raw,
+	}))
+	caPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.pem")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(caPath, []byte(ca), 0600))
+
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name       string
+		cfg        config.RedisCacheConfig
+		wantTLS    bool
+		wantRoots  bool
+		wantVerify bool
+	}{
+		{name: "plaintext"},
+		{name: "system roots", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true}, wantTLS: true, wantVerify: true},
+		{name: "inline CA", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: ca}, wantTLS: true, wantRoots: true},
+		{name: "CA file", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: caPath}, wantTLS: true, wantRoots: true},
+		{name: "insecure", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, InsecureSkipTLS: true}, wantTLS: true},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tt.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+
+			tlsConfig := client.Options().TLSConfig
+			if !tt.wantTLS {
+				assert.Nil(t, tlsConfig)
+				return
+			}
+			require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig)
+			assert.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), tlsConfig.MinVersion)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantRoots, tlsConfig.RootCAs != nil)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.name == "insecure", tlsConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+
+			conn, err := tls.DialWithDialer(&net.Dialer{Timeout: time.Second}, "tcp", strings.TrimPrefix(server.URL, "https://"), tlsConfig)
+			if tt.wantVerify {
+				require.Error(t, err)
+				var unknownAuthority x509.UnknownAuthorityError
+				assert.True(t, errors.As(err, &unknownAuthority), "expected unknown authority error, got %v", err)
+				return
+			}
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.NoError(t, conn.Close())
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewClientInvalidCA(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name    string
+		cfg     config.RedisCacheConfig
+		wantErr string
+	}{
+		{
+			name:    "conflicting CA sources",
+			cfg:     config.RedisCacheConfig{CaCertPath: "ca.pem", CaCertBytes: "certificate"},
+			wantErr: "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "missing CA file",
+			cfg:     config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing.pem")},
+			wantErr: "reading redis CA certificate",
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "invalid inline CA",
+			cfg:     config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "invalid PEM"},
+			wantErr: "invalid redis CA certificate",
+		},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tt.cfg)
+			assert.Nil(t, client)
+			require.ErrorContains(t, err, tt.wantErr)
+		})
+	}
+}
